relics.name: the tuning hammer
relics.text: It finds the note a thing is holding. Struck often enough, most things stop holding it.

relics.name: the still lamp
relics.text: It consumes nothing and it never gutters. It never burns bright, either: you see less, for longer.

relics.name: the patient mirror
relics.text: It shows the room half a breath early. The first blow of any fight arrives to a body already moving.

relics.name: the pilgrim's bell
relics.text: Too small to hear. The things that wait in the dark hear it, and stop waiting.

relics.name: the assayer's seal
relics.text: A brass thumbprint of an epoch that kept immaculate books. Any broker's hand goes honest around it.
